items.q: We had a meeting in Burns's hotel suite and planned everything. There was Joe Hayman, Herman Chittison, Fletcher Allen, Burns and myself... His name was Arthur Pay.

ctx.x: Some of us had began to get a little fed up with Willie and Burns knew who they were. So he told us about the Alexandria deal and the loot was good. We therefore decided to form a group and keep it a secret. We had a meeting in Burns's hotel suite and planned everything. There was

Joe Hayman, Herman Chittison, Fletcher Allen, Burns and myself. We contacted "Spider" Courance who was still working at the Villa d'Este and Burns knew a drummer from Holland who was a Negro born in the Dutch West Indies. His name was Arthur Pay. Pastraudis said that there was an Italian bass player already in Alexandria.

We left Paris by train for Italy the 5th of December 1938 without telling anything to anybody and sailed from Genoa the following day, on the Italian liner Esperia. On board I met the leader of a Cuban orchestra whom Pastraudis had engaged as an Argentina Orchestra. He was a violinist named Bernardo Alemany. We had a wonderful trip but when we arrived at Alexandria we could not leave the boat because Pastraudis did not have the working permits for us.
